column1: # Recall floor per language directory under tree/. Fields, tab separated:
#   language      the directory name under tree/, which is also the family
#   recall_floor  fraction of that language's positives the profiles must report
#   measured_at   the value measured when the language landed, as a date
#   ticket        what the number was measured for
# Every floor is the MEASURED value at the time the language landed -
# descriptive, not aspirational. A language whose positives contract a known
# gap starts low on purpose; the ticket that closes the gap raises the floor in
# the same commit that moves the number. What a floor forbids is regression.
# A language directory carrying positives with no row here fails the harness by
# name rather than being measured against a floor nobody wrote down.
